author: Claude
purpose: Development set to CALIBRATE abstention (G201 Q1, G220-6). Superset of dev-calibration-v1 (24 questions kept verbatim) plus 36 new ones, including near_miss questions that share vocabulary with a document but whose answer is absent. corpus-v1 questions stay the held-out test set: never tune on them.
rule: Frozen by SHA-256 before any threshold is tuned. A change needs a new file and version. Expected ids refer to corpus-v1 documents; off_topic and near_miss expect abstention.
